mentions.name: Agent Friendly Code
mentions.description: A tool that scores a codebase for different AI coding agents using their static signals, helping users find out which agent might perform better in their codebase.
mentions.audience: Developers deciding which AI coding agent to use on their codebase
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://agentfriendlycode.com/

The project lets you find out which agent might perform better in your codebase. It scores the codebase for different agents using their static signals and gives you a response.

mentions.name: Agent-friendly scorer
mentions.description: This tool scores public repositories for their agent friendliness. It ships a GitHub Action that posts the score delta as a PR comment, and can be added as a skill to determine which agent performs better on a codebase.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on the agent-friendly scorer. It scores the public repos for their agent friendliness. The project also has a GitHub action to comment on the score delta in a PR comment. You can add it as a skill to find out which agent will perform better for the codebase.
